summary: Fixed the test_ar.py shard in statsmodels/tsa/ar_model.py: AutoReg nonrobust scale and covariance without the OLS df correction, apply() argument validation and too-short-data errors, a specification check for fewer observations than regressors, old_names intercept naming, zero-regressor fit and summary, the plot_predict in-sample guard, and date-based forecast steps, plus PandasData xnames/ynames setters in statsmodels/base/data.py. The last run I saw was test_ar.py plus base/tests/test_data.py, not the full suite: 3778 passed, 209 failed, and none of my 930 shard tests failed in it (the remaining failures are other fixers' test_equiv, conf_int and append tests).
